mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last two quarters signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer confidence improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the quarters where real GDP increases, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals a contraction in supply, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions and reduced output impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it indicates a tight labor market with strong job growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are positively impacted.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months signals strong demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector and related industries experience growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the periods where housing starts increase, or if the correlation between housing starts growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs rise.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% within the last month signals weakening consumer demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
